sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Governance and Oversight Policy establishes the framework for managing AI risks and oversight for {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all AI components within the system boundary defined as {boundary} and ensures the protection of data including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. AI Risk Reporting and Cadence

questions.prompt: What is the defined cadence for producing the AI risk report?
Who is responsible for the production and review of the AI risk report?

sections.body: To ensure continuous oversight, an AI risk report is produced on a cadence of {risk_report_cadence}. The production and review of these reports are managed by {risk_report_owner}.

sections.heading: 3. High-Risk AI Use Identification and Control

questions.prompt: What are the defined criteria used to identify high-risk AI use cases?
What additional controls are applied specifically to high-risk AI uses?

sections.body: AI use cases are classified as high-risk based on the following criteria: {high_risk_criteria}. For all AI uses meeting these criteria, the organization applies additional security and ethical controls consisting of {high_risk_controls}.
